maxillary_keypoint_topology.keypoint_spatial_matrix: Four keypoints are distributed in a linear sequence with an inter-point distance of roughly 1.5 times the individual spot diameter, oriented parallel to the secondary dense row positioned ventrally.

rhinarium_pixel_ratio.melanin_saturation_percentage: Dark melanin-saturated pixels occupy approximately 98% of the visible rhinarium surface, with minor high-key specular highlights and no visible pale or pink tissue.

cranial_profile_vector.frontal_slope_angle: The lateral profile presents a continuous contour from the superior orbital ridge to the nasal bridge at an estimated interior angle of 145 degrees.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Localized depigmented scarring is visible across the bridge of the nose, accompanied by a distinct light-furred patch situated superior to the orbital ridge.
other_distinctive_markers: Melanistic hair clusters are observed on the posterior and dorsal margins of the mane.
